name: steledb
description: A TypeScript library that treats a set of JSON files as a static relational database, deriving integrity validation and typed queries from one schema definition

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs && chmod +x dist/cli/main.js
scripts.check:example: npm --prefix examples install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix examples run check
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test && npm run check:core-imports && npm run check:example
